attempts.query: SAVA R21 Gelaro S4 long term review bottom bracket flex compliance
attempts.note: The author reports more than 1,800 km and describes no noticeable bottom-bracket-area flex while climbing, useful stay compliance over washboard and stable descending. This is qualitative ride evidence, not a measured stiffness test.

notes: The site records the qualitative ride report with its source class and does not convert it into a stiffness score.
